title: AiDecisionCard output (v1.0.0)
description: Produced on 'Send answers'. Same structure as the AB decision-form export (12/08/2026), plus engine, lang, multi and own_answer. Inline mode posts a readable line followed by this JSON in a ```json block; standalone mode shows it with Copy/Download JSON + Markdown; onSubmit receives {line, json}.

lang.description: Language the card was shown in.

answer.description: Option key (single), array of keys (multi), or null. '__other' = own answer.

answer_label.description: Displayed label(s) matching 'answer', in the display language.

own_answer.description: Text typed for 'My own answer'; empty when not chosen.

notes.description: Per-question comment; empty when not filled.

missing_blocking.description: Blocking question ids left unanswered (always empty when sent from the card, since sending is blocked).
